mechanic_intro: ^Look at this. If you are planning to use this C4 to clear the upper corridor, you are going to earn it first.
^I happened to drop the detonator somewhere inside that green storage room. Pitch black. And I am certainly not stepping foot in there.
^Go retrieve it from the dark. Bring it back to me in one piece, and maybe-just maybe-I will hand over the explosive.

c-0: ^Where? Somewhere among the shadows and the dust. It is a maze in there, not a gift shop. Open your eyes. Or rather, let the light do the work.
c-1: ^Tick-tock. Make it quick and watch your step in the dark.

mechanic_waiting: ^I told you to find the detonator. Stop wasting my time and get it.
mechanic_done: ^You actually made it back... Fascinating. Here is your precious C4. Do whatever you want with it, just get out of my sight.
mechanic_leave_me: ^I already gave you what you wanted.
